title: Claude Code · Breakdown
description: Every event and every timed operation (model calls per model, tools, hooks, MCP connects) on one scale: what happens most, what takes longest, what fails most, and where the time goes.

panels.title: Time by kind
panels.description: Summed durations: model calls, tools (imported history includes permission waits), hooks and MCP connects.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*", claude_profile=~"$profile", event_name="api_request"} | model=~"$model" | label_format op=`model · {{ if or (not .model) (eq .model "<synthetic>") }}unknown (imported errors){{ else }}{{.model}}{{ end }}`, kind=`model` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range])) / 1000 or sum by (kind) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*", claude_profile=~"$profile", event_name="tool_result"} | label_format op=`tool · {{.tool_name}}`, kind=`tool` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range])) / 1000 or sum by (kind) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*", claude_profile=~"$profile", event_name="hook_execution_complete"} | label_format op=`hook · {{.hook_event}}`, kind=`hook` | unwrap total_duration_ms [$__range])) / 1000 or sum by (kind) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*", claude_profile=~"$profile", event_name="mcp_server_connection"} | status!="disconnected" | label_format op=`MCP connect · {{.server_name}}`, kind=`MCP` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range])) / 1000

panels.title: Model time by source
